cases.question: ABAP 7.54에서 일반 CALL FUNCTION, 처리한 비클래스 예외, IN UPDATE TASK 등록 직후의 sy-subrc를 구분하세요.
conditions: Standard ABAP 7.54 syntax; no claim about ABAP Cloud API release
Ordinary call versus handled non-class-based exception versus update registration must be separated
supporting_quotes: The system field sy-subrc is set to 0 when a function module is called.
If a non-class-based exception is raised that was handled by the assignment of a value, sy-subrc is set to this value.
After the registration of an update function module using CALL FUNCTION ... IN UPDATE TASK , sy-subrc is undefined.
cases.oracle_origin: Manual inspection of live SAP Help body; no model judge

conditions: Aggregate-only projection must not be generalized from ordinary empty-result behavior
supporting_quotes: The statement SELECT sets sy-subrc to 4 if the results set is empty.
Special rules apply when only aggregate expressions specified as columns are used in the SELECT list of the SELECT clause.
